ideas.pitch: An edge-AI computer vision garbage classification system deployed on low-cost IoT nodes that routes recyclable data to municipal dashboards.
ideas.problem_statement: Promote Social and Environmental Sustainability by developing innovative approaches that support healthy, sustainable, and thriving communities through environmental innovation.
ideas.title: EcoSort AI: Smart Municipal Waste Segregation Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the hackathon's core mandate on environmental sustainability and social impact while demonstrating a physical, working prototype similar to past hardware-software hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent LLM framework that processes remote IoT sensor data and drone imagery to autonomously diagnose soil anomalies and trigger precision irrigation protocols.
ideas.problem_statement: Solve Real-World Problems Work on meaningful challenges that address real issues affecting society, industry, and the environment through IoT and AI.
ideas.title: AgriDiag: Autonomous Multi-Agent Crop Disease & Irrigation Ops
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced multi-agent orchestration which impresses technical judges, tackling critical agricultural challenges prevalent across India.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge gated medical collaboration platform allowing rural health workers to share patient symptom data securely without violating privacy regulations.
ideas.problem_statement: Innovate and Grow Gain valuable experience through mentorship and hands-on exploration of emerging technologies such as HealthTech.
ideas.title: MedChain ZK: Privacy-Preserving HealthTech Records
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles high-stakes data privacy in the HealthTech domain using cryptographic primitives, offering a level of technical depth that stands out to judges.

ideas.pitch: An on-chain verifiable credential issuing platform utilizing lightweight federated learning to assess student practical coding submissions without exposing raw user data.
ideas.problem_statement: Empowering participants to transform their ideas into practical solutions that create a meaningful impact on education and industry.
ideas.title: EduLearn Sync: Decentralized Credential & Skill Verification
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines education tech with decentralized data integrity, targeting both societal impact and novel web3 architectural patterns.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous operations platform that ingests live energy meter time-series data, runs anomaly detection models, and flags grid failure risks before outages happen.
ideas.problem_statement: Solve Real-World Problems Work on meaningful challenges that address real issues affecting society, industry, and the environment.
ideas.title: GridPulse IoT: Predictive Micro-Grid Maintenance Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on hard engineering and robust anomaly detection pipelines that guarantee a tangible, working live demo for the evaluation panel.
